claims.assessment: An author field-case demonstration with multiple data groups. Native code, data/weights and PartI derivations are absent; no independent reproduction, probabilistic certainty or unique permeability field.
Author inference from incompatible fits, parameter bounds and instrument swapping. Raw logger/QA evidence is unavailable. Preserve the explicit caveat that a barrier cannot be excluded.

claims.claim: Sparse ERT can be calibrated with process/geological constraints
claims.assessment: Demonstrated within chosen priors and filtered data. Lost coverage and nonuniqueness remain; no independent resolution/uncertainty study reproduced.

claims.claim: Ambient laboratory n bounds reflect heterogeneity
claims.assessment: Samples give bounds1.62–2.6; original conditions are unverified. A constant field n at the lower bound can compensate for model limits. It is not a measured global exponent.

claims.claim: Permeability maps resolve heterogeneity without a barrier
claims.assessment: Maps are conditional on model and data rejection. Authors explicitly retain weak resolution and barrier nonexclusion. No proof of absence or unique field.

claims.claim: Salt explains local15mD/factor8, skin and doubled pressure
claims.assessment: An equivalent model interpretation supported by cited PNG, with dynamic processes unverified. Static skin10.1 is a first approximation; no eightfold annual injection decline follows.

claims.claim: Selective infiltration and non-Darcy alternatives can be rejected
claims.assessment: Authors use external June2009 PNG and Re~1e−7. Original saturation states, definitions and inputs are unavailable; these exclusions are not independently reproduced.

claims.claim: Convergence is fast and stable in3–5 iterations
claims.assessment: Reported case; iteration5 retained before later artifacts. Full regularisation/iteration traces, runtimes and alternative starts are absent. No global optimality or independent validation.
Table arithmetic is compatible with rounding. Weighted normalised cost reduction differs from raw error, explained variance, storage or safety improvement. ERT downweighting remains explicit.
Seven retained calibration panels agree qualitatively; switch residuals are attributed to cell size. Complete raw series, held-out validation and barrier resolution are absent.

claims.claim: Arrivals have the best fit at.5/4% error
claims.assessment: Limited arithmetic matches rounding. Two observations, well/sensor delays and the3% model proxy limit interpretation. Class2015 supports shared observations and uncertainty, not these new predictions.
Figure6 shows variation matching while absolute offsets are allowed by differencing. Absolute pressure controls and transient salt dynamics remain unverified.
All retained data enter the inversion, but panelb is poorly matched and downweighted. Filter mapping, constant n, ambient transfer, annulus effects and covariance remain unresolved.
Qualitative NW/S comparison with earlier NW/S/west observations. No independent quantitative plume/horizon validation or retained-mass balance is supplied.

claims.claim: Regularisation mitigates insensitive parameters and structural noise
claims.assessment: Author claim relies on PartI implementation. Priors, bias and residual noise are not independently quantified; absolute offsets remain. No claim that all uncertainty is eliminated.

claims.claim: Seismic/PNG extensions could improve future assessment
claims.assessment: Proposed future assimilation. It does not establish completed new capacity, retention, access or netGHG results.
